desc: Ideation complete: identify phase constraints, four diagonal directions, clockwise mapping, and candidate DP approaches.
Implement straight-run DP for all four diagonal directions and two phases using compact flat arrays or memory-safe structures.
Implement directional prefix DP from starting 1s, scanning each direction in topological order, and combine each prefix with the clockwise straight-run suffix to update the answer.
Handle edge cases: no 1, single 1, straight-only segments, turn at boundaries, phase preservation after turn, and verify examples.
